infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is recorded only between clock-in and clock-out so your employer can verify hours on site.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Your location is recorded only between clock-in and clock-out so your employer can verify hours on site, even when the app is in the background. Tracking stops completely when you clock out.
